description: Find newly issued Horry County construction permits that may create sales opportunities for networking, low-voltage, security, AV, POS, electrical, or related contractors. Returns ranked leads with transparent trigger signals and project details.

city.description: Optional city filter such as Myrtle Beach, Conway, or Surfside Beach

days_back.description: How many days back to search. Default 14, maximum 30.

max_results.description: Maximum leads to return. Default 10, maximum 50.

min_project_value.description: Minimum recorded permit project value in USD. Default 0.

trade.description: Opportunity type to score permits for

name: find_construction_leads
